zh.title: 从视觉观察到持续任务执行
zh.description: Policy根据当前画面、近期历史与任务上下文生成控制，并按需请求局部更新或Brain重规划。下方展示两阶段监督训练。
zh.alt: 论文框架图：GTA V画面和历史输入ZETA Policy，结合阶段指令、局部思考和任务记忆，输出手柄动作并连接外部Brain。
zh.note: 每个动作包含左右摇杆与两个有序的 100ms 按键状态。

en.title: From visual feedback to sustained action
en.description: Policy uses the current frame, recent history and retained task context to generate controls, with local updates or Brain replanning when needed. The lower panel outlines two supervised training stages.
en.alt: Paper framework: game images and bounded history feed ZETA Policy, with retained instruction, reasoning and memory, gamepad actions and external Brain updates.
en.note: Each action combines both sticks with two ordered 100ms button states.

zh.title: 从对齐轨迹到当前决策样本
zh.description: 画面、真实手柄动作和任务标注共享时间轴；阶段指令、局部思考、任务记忆、历史与当前观察共同构成输入。
zh.alt: 论文数据样本图：对齐的驾驶录像与动作、任务状态的有效时间，以及当前画面、小地图、OCR和空think动作响应。
zh.note: 样本将任务状态与当前观察对齐，小地图取自同一帧。

en.title: From an aligned trajectory to a decision sample
en.description: Game frames, recorded controls and task annotations share a timeline. Stage instructions, local reasoning, task memory, recent history and the current observation condition the response.
en.alt: Diagram showing aligned gameplay and actions, effective task state, current frame, minimap, OCR and an empty-think action response.
en.note: Task state is aligned with the current observation, including a minimap from the same frame.

zh.title: 两阶段训练与滚动窗口监督
zh.description: 动作预训练采用20轮窗口；指令微调采用16轮、保留8轮。图中展示目标响应在下一窗口转为历史，以及三种响应的监督边界。
zh.alt: 论文训练图：20轮动作预训练、16轮保留8轮的指令微调窗口，以及继续执行、局部更新和Brain请求三种响应的监督范围。
zh.note: 橙色下划线表示参与监督的目标；保留历史和起始think标签作为输入，空think的关闭标签也参与监督。

en.title: Two-stage training and rolling-window supervision
en.description: Action pretraining uses 20-round windows; instruction tuning uses 16 rounds and retains eight. The diagram shows supervised targets becoming history in the next window, with three response continuations expanded below.
en.alt: Paper training diagram showing 20-round action pretraining, rolling 16/8 instruction-tuning windows, and supervision for continuation, local updates and Brain requests.
en.note: Amber underlined continuations receive supervision. Retained history and the opening think tag are inputs; the closing tag of an empty think is supervised.

zh.title: 控制继续，任务上下文按需更新
zh.description: 局部think请求Brain更新记忆；周期刷新生成记忆与思考；完整Brain调用重新审视全部字段。背景前缀准备可服务这三种请求。
zh.alt: 论文Harness图：观察到Policy和动作的闭环，以及局部更新、周期刷新、完整Brain调用和可选背景prefill。
zh.note: 局部更新在配置的交接点激活；完整Brain调用先确认游戏暂停，再提交新状态并恢复。

en.title: Continuous control, context updates when needed
en.description: Local think requests Brain memory, periodic refresh requests memory and reasoning, and a full Brain call reviews all fields. Optional background prefill serves these request types.
en.alt: Paper harness diagram showing the observation–Policy–action loop, local updates, periodic refresh, full Brain calls and optional background prefill.
en.note: Local updates activate at the configured handoff boundary. Full Brain calls confirm pause before committing context and resuming.

zh.title: 准备已知前缀，衔接双路推理与执行
zh.description: 裁剪16轮历史并保留最近8轮，先准备已知前缀，待完整响应和新观察到齐后继续生成。两条TP4路与200ms动作窗口并行运行。
zh.alt: 论文双路推理图：已知前缀与后续响应、观察的拼接，以及两条TP4路交替生成、准备和按200ms窗口执行控制的时序。
zh.note: 实线表示前缀复用，虚线表示完成响应的依赖，橙色标记表示提前就绪的控制状态等待指定起点。

en.title: Preparing known prefixes for dual-route inference and control
en.description: After trimming 16 rounds to the latest eight, the known prefix is prepared first; the completed response and new observation are appended before generation. Two TP4 routes overlap preparation and inference with scheduled 200ms control.
en.alt: Paper diagram showing known-prefix preparation, appending the completed response and new observation, and dual-TP4 generation overlapping scheduled 200ms control.
en.note: Solid arrows reuse prepared prefixes; dashed arrows carry completed responses. The amber marker shows an early control state waiting for its assigned start.

zh.title: 论文中的推理效率实验
zh.description: Qwen3.5-9B、BF16、H200，15轮完整历史加当前观察，固定生成20个token。左图独立移除优化组件；右图在相同Graph512条件下比较TP规模。
zh.alt: 论文推理效率图：TP4组件移除对照和TP1、TP2、TP4、TP8的平均请求延迟。
zh.note: 所有配置使用相同16个场景，每场景在两个节点上各重复5次（每节点80次，共160次请求），均采用32768个视觉嵌入的缓存和16384-token批处理预算。左图TP4、Graph8192；右图Graph512。计时不含图片上传与先前的前缀准备。固定20个输出token用于比较服务开销；实际部署在完整动作生成后停止。

en.title: Inference efficiency reported in the paper
en.description: Qwen3.5-9B, BF16, H200, with 15 completed history rounds plus the current observation and 20 generated tokens. The left panel removes one optimization at a time; the right compares TP sizes at a shared Graph512 limit.
en.alt: Paper inference-efficiency figure with TP4 component-removal controls and mean request latency at TP1, TP2, TP4 and TP8.
en.note: Every configuration uses the same 16 scenes, repeated five times on each of two nodes (80 requests per node, 160 total), with a 32768-embedding visual cache and a 16384-token batch budget. Left: TP4, Graph8192. Right: Graph512. Timing excludes image upload and prior prefix preparation. Fixed 20-token outputs isolate serving cost; deployed generation stops at a complete action.
